text: Peter gave himself up for lost, and shed big tears; but his sobs were overheard by some friendly sparrows, who flew to him in great excitement, and implored him to exert himself. Mr. McGregor came up with a sieve, which he intended to pop upon the top of Peter; but Peter wriggled out just in time, leaving his jacket behind him.
title: Peter's Escape
director_note: Friendly sparrows circle above Peter at staggered heights to urge him on, while McGregor looms at the right edge until Peter wriggles free without his jacket. The staging keeps the rescue hopeful and lively, with clear spacing and a last-second escape.
